course.title: 2D Animation

days.title: Meet animation

video.title: 2D Animation for Beginners: Ultimate Tutorial and Workflow

steps: Watch a short cartoon and notice how it moves.

quiz.q: What is a frame in animation?
options: One still picture. Many frames played fast look like movement
A whole cartoon from start to finish
The screen your cartoon plays on
A drawing of a camera
quiz.explain: A frame is one picture. When many frames play quickly, your eyes see movement.

Draw a full cartoon straight away
